snippet.title: Abyss Ring - Trailer 2024 December
snippet.description:
Survive, cook, and conquer the depths!
In this survival roguelike, cook monsters to stave off hunger as you descend through 100 floors of randomly generated dungeons. With over 200 types of equipment to discover and stunning high-quality graphics, every playthrough offers fresh challenges and endless possibilities. Will you master the art of survival and reach the bottom?

Steam Store: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3401570/Abyss_Ring/
X: https://x.com/studio_northern
